name: Cloud Key
oracle_text:
As this artifact enters, choose artifact, creature, enchantment, instant, or sorcery.
Spells you cast of the chosen type cost {1} less to cast.
blocked_sentences: As this artifact enters, choose artifact, creature, enchantment, instant, or sorcery
Spells you cast of the chosen type cost {1} less to cast

needs.what: choose_type over a printed subset of card types (Artifact, Creature, Enchantment, Instant, Sorcery) writing chosen_card_type, e.g. an `options` list on choose_type
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_type's only fixed axes are `permanent_type` (six permanent types, no Instant/Sorcery) and `card_type` (all nine of 205.2a, adding Battle, Kindred, Land and Planeswalker); neither offers exactly the five printed choices, and offering Planeswalker/Battle/Kindred would discount spells the printed card cannot

needs.what: spell_cost_reduction whose affects_spells.types may hold {"chosen_card_type_of": "self"}, substituted with the source's chosen_card_type when pricing a spell
needs.why_existing_wont_do: player_statics.spell_cost_reduction resolves only chosen_type_of (creature subtype) and chosen_color_of in its filter; chosen_card_type_of is resolved only in effect selectors and protection from_types, so a spell filter naming it would match nothing
